description_en: Call the DescribeDcdnDomainRealTimeReqHitRateData operation to query the real-time request hit rate of one or more accelerated domain names
description_zh: 调用DescribeDcdnDomainRealTimeReqHitRateData查询域名实时请求命中率数据
name: DescribeDcdnDomainRealTimeReqHitRateData

parameters.help_en: The accelerated domain name. You can specify one or more domain names. Separate multiple domain names with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 加速域名，多个用英文逗号（,）隔开
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 起始时间，日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

The end time must be later than the start time
parameters.help_zh:
结束时间，日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。

结束时间需大于起始时间
parameters.name: end_time
